title: Literature-derived RNA–RNA interaction fixtures for vaRRI-js
curationRules: No base pairs are inferred from interaction-region coordinates alone.
Meyer records preserve the deposited full sequences and site pairing strings exactly.
Dots outside an annotated Meyer interaction mean “no base pair annotation in this dataset”, not experimental proof of an unpaired state.
Every imported Meyer pair is independently checked for length, balanced pairing, and canonical or G–U complementarity.
Gallery cases are imported from examples.js rather than retyped.
HIV DIS sequences are copied from RCSB mmCIF polymer records and cross-checked against a published secondary-structure figure.

linearcofold-2023.citation: Zhang H, Li S, Dai N, Zhang L, Mathews DH, Huang L. LinearCoFold and LinearCoPartition: linear-time algorithms for secondary structure prediction of interacting RNA molecules. Nucleic Acids Research. 2023;51(18):e94.
linearcofold-2023.relevance: Defines the deposited Meyer dataset as 109 bacterial sRNA–mRNA pairs with annotated intermolecular ground-truth base pairs and states that the interactions were experimentally validated with compensatory mutations.

linearcofold-zenodo-8153422.citation: Zhang H, Li S, Dai N, Zhang L, Mathews D, Huang L. LinearCoFold and LinearCoPartition dataset. Zenodo. 2023.

lai-meyer-2016.citation: Lai D, Meyer IM. A comprehensive comparison of general RNA–RNA interaction prediction methods. Nucleic Acids Research. 2016;44(7):e61.

ennifar-dumas-2006.citation: Ennifar E, Dumas P. Polymorphism of bulged-out residues in HIV-1 RNA DIS kissing complex and structure comparison with solution studies. Journal of Molecular Biology. 2006;356(3):771–782.

reblova-2007.type: primary research article with secondary-structure cross-check
reblova-2007.citation: Réblová K, Fadrná E, Sarzynska J, et al. Conformations of flanking bases in HIV-1 RNA DIS kissing complexes studied by molecular dynamics. Biophysical Journal. 2007;93(11):3932–3949.

rcsb-1xpf.citation: RCSB PDB 1XPF: HIV-1 subtype A genomic RNA Dimerization Initiation Site.

rcsb-1xpe.citation: RCSB PDB 1XPE: HIV-1 subtype B genomic RNA Dimerization Initiation Site.

gallery-source-wu-2024.citation: Wu et al., 2024. RNA interactome of hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae reveals a small RNA inhibitor of capsular mucoviscosity and virulence.
